AEAssessmentApplication.doc: A representation of an app that users can access during an assessment.

AEAssessmentConfiguration.doc: Configuration information for an assessment session.

AEAssessmentParticipantConfiguration.doc: Configuration information for an app that’s available during an assessment.

AEAssessmentSession.doc: A session that your app uses to protect an assessment.

AEAssessmentSessionDelegate.doc: An interface that the session uses to provide information about session state changes to a delegate.

AEAssessmentErrorCode.doc: Error codes that the framework returns if a session fails.

AEAutocorrectMode.doc: The set of autocorrect features that you can enable during an assessment.

-initWithBundleIdentifier:.doc: Creates a representation of an app using its bundle identifier.

-initWithBundleIdentifier:teamIdentifier.doc: Creates a representation of an app using its bundle and team identifiers.

-removeApplication:.doc: Removes the availability of a previously allowed app.

-setConfiguration:forApplication:.doc: Adds an app to the list of apps available during an assessment.

+new.doc: Creates a new assessment participant configuration instance.

-allowedMenuItemsForLanguageIdentifier:.doc: Returns the set of allowed menu item titles for the given language identifier, or @c nil if no items have been configured for that identifier.

-init.doc: Initializes an assessment participant configuration instance.

-setAllowedMenuItems:forLanguageIdentifi.doc: Sets the allowed menu item titles for the given language identifier.

-updateToConfiguration:.doc: Changes the session to use the specified configuration.

bundleIdentifier.doc: The bundle identifier of the app.

requiresSignatureValidation.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether the session requires the app to have a valid code signature to run.

teamIdentifier.doc: The team identifier of the app.

AEAutocorrectMode.doc: The set of autocorrect features that you can enable during an assessment.

allowLockdownMode.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the assessment allows Lockdown Mode to be active.

allowOnlyParticipantsToRun.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether only participant applications are allowed to run during an assessment.

allowPrivateRelay.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the assessment allows iCloud Private Relay to be active.

allowedAppleMenuItems.doc: The set of allowed Apple menu items during an assessment.

allowedDirectoriesAndFiles.doc: The set of allowed directories and files that participants can access during an assessment.

allowedMenuBarItems.doc: The set of menu bar items that should remain visible during an assessment.

allowsAccessibilityAlternativeInputMetho.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow alternative input methods for accessibility features during an assessment.

allowsAccessibilityBackgroundSounds.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow Background Sounds during an assessment.

allowsAccessibilityHoverText.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow Hover Text during an assessment.

allowsAccessibilityKeyboard.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow the Accessibility Keyboard during an assessment.

allowsAccessibilityLiveCaptions.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow Live Captions during an assessment.

allowsAccessibilityLiveSpeech.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow Live Speech during an assessment.

allowsAccessibilityReader.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow the Accessibility Reader during an assessment.

allowsAccessibilitySpeech.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow the speech-related accessibility features during an assessment.

allowsAccessibilitySpokenContent.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow Spoken Content during an assessment.

allowsAccessibilitySwitchControl.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow Switch Control during an assessment.

allowsAccessibilityTypingFeedback.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow accessibility typing feedback during an assessment.

allowsAccessibilityVoiceControl.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow Voice Control during an assessment.

allowsAccessibilityVoiceOver.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow VoiceOver during an assessment.

allowsAccessibilityZoom.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow Zoom during an assessment.

allowsActivityContinuation.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow Handoff during an assessment.

allowsAutoFill.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow autofill during an assessment.

allowsContinuousPathKeyboard.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow Slide to Type to operate during an assessment.

allowsDictation.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow the use of dictation during an assessment.

allowsDock.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow the Dock during an assessment.

allowsEmojiKeyboard.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow the emoji keyboard during an assessment.

allowsKeyboardShortcuts.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow keyboard shortcuts during an assessment.

allowsMenuBar.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow the menu bar during an assessment.

allowsPasswordAutoFill.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow password autofill during an assessment.

allowsPredictiveKeyboard.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to enable the predictive keyboard during an assessment.

allowsScreenshots.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow screenshots copied to the clipboard during an assessment.

allowsSpellCheck.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow spell check during an assessment.

allowsStructuralInput.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow Chinese and Japanese structural input during an assessment.

allowsUserScriptExecution.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow user script execution during an assessment.

autocorrectMode.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to allow Autocorrect during an assessment.

configurationsByApplication.doc: The collection of apps available during an assessment, along with their associated configurations.

mainParticipantConfiguration.doc: The app-specific configuration for the app that invokes the assessment.

requiresManagedDevice.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the device must be managed to start an assessment.

requiresSIP.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether System Integrity Protection (SIP) must be enabled to start an assessment.

requiresSingleUser.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether only a single user account must be logged in to start an assessment.

requiresUserAccountType.doc: Specifies the type of user account required to start an assessment.

allowedMenuItemLanguageIdentifiers.doc: The set of language identifiers for which allowed menu items have been configured.

allowedMenuItemLanguages.doc: The set of languages for which allowed menu items have been configured.

allowedMenuItems(for:).doc: Returns the set of allowed menu item titles for the given language, or nil if no items have been configured for that language.

allowsNetworkAccess.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether an app can access network resources during an assessment.

setAllowedMenuItems(_:for:).doc: Sets the allowed menu item titles for the given language.

active.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether an assessment session is running.

configuration.doc: The current configuration of the session.

delegate.doc: A delegate to which the session provides state change updates.

supportsConfigurationUpdates.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether the current device or platform supports updating a session’s configuration after the session has begun.

supportsMultipleParticipants.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether the current device or platform supports a configuration with one or more participant applications.
